description: ODC (context: agent app). A CrossDevice app refuses agents ('Agent objects can't be children of App objects'). Over the blank AIAgent module (create-blank --kind AIAgent --connection ai-model:CovAIModel) the agent is born, with action handler, and is called by a server action (Call Agent) and directly from the model (Call Agent Core). The AI model of an agent has to be an action of an AI model connection ('A IServerAction cannot be used as the value for IAgent.AIModel'): the fixture brings a connection built offline (IModelServices.CreateAIModelConnection + IESpace.AddDependency), referenced by IServerActionSignature:CovAIModel. Messages is a list of AIMessage; '[]' is enough for the Verify.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app does not expose a public server action (the live Studio errors); CovGAsk stays private and without a consumer in this job. CovGLookup does not need it: the agent uses it as a tool

ops._why: the Messages argument of the agent: without an expression, ArgumentRequiredExpression
